style: Calm, precise, technical. A results grid that builds cell by cell on a transparent background; pills, not a spreadsheet. Matches the Remotion house set (docs/videos/*.webm).
font: Inter 400-800 + JetBrains Mono 400-700 (local woff2 in assets/fonts)

customize.note: Hand-authored: a 6x5 categorical status grid is not a bar/line chart, so data-chart does not fit.

content.headline: Did the canary secret reach Claude?

captions.text: The environment is the door nobody closes.

content.footnote: * .claudeignore: Claude chose to honour it. The docs say it has no effect.

shot_brief: A title and stat line settle top-left, the five attack-route headers fade in, then the article's results table builds one setup per ~0.9 s: each row's label slides in and its five verdicts stamp in left to right as pills (rose LEAKED, mint HELD, amber HELD* for the two .claudeignore cells the model merely chose to honour). After the fourth row the whole printenv / env column lights up rose (pattern interrupt) with the caption 'The environment is the door nobody closes.' Row five (+ sandbox.credentials) lands all mint, its band takes a mint highlight and the caption becomes 'All three layers: nothing leaked.' Row six (sandbox runtime) lands with the env cell still rose. The footnote fades in and the complete table holds for ~2.6 s. Dominant motif: verdict pills stamping in.

motion.title: fade + y 14->0, power3.out, 0.6s
motion.column_glow: fade in 0.5s power2.out, one sine.inOut breath, then dims to a quieter state at row 5
